```instr
DEFINE INSTRUMENT tof_imaging(lam=3.5, dlam=1.3, ap_D=0.016)

COMPONENT src = Source_simple(
  yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.1, dist=1.0, 
  focus_xw=ap_D, focus_yh=ap_D, 
  lambda0=lam, dlambda=dlam, 
  flux=1e13
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT aperture = Slit(
  radius=0.5*ap_D
) AT (0, 0, 1.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT scraper = Slit(
  xwidth=0.3, yheight=0.3
) AT (0, 0, 10.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT fov_mon = PSD_monitor(
  nx=128, ny=128, filename="fov.dat", 
  xwidth=0.28, yheight=0.28, 
  restore_neutron=1
) AT (0, 0, 20.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det = PSD_monitor(
  nx=256, ny=256, filename="det.dat", 
  xwidth=0.2, yheight=0.2, 
  restore_neutron=1
) AT (0, 0, 25.0) RELATIVE src

COMPONENT det_lam = L_monitor(
  nL=200, filename="det_lam.dat", 
  xwidth=0.2, yheight=0.2, 
  Lmin=lam-2*dlam, Lmax=lam+2*dlam, 
  restore_neutron=1
) AT (0, 0, 25.01) RELATIVE src

END
```
